acme-dev: Hey @julia.support — our webhook integration started returning 401 invalid_api_key around 10:30 UTC after a deploy. We copied the key from the dashboard yesterday using the little copy icon and put it into our header. Example curl we use:

acme-dev: ```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer svc-prod-abc123" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate"
```

acme-dev: Response is `{"error":"invalid_api_key","code":401}`. Any ideas?

julia.support: Thanks — sorry about the disruption. A couple quick asks: can you paste the exact Authorization header (you can mask middle chars) and confirm whether you copied from the token list view or the token detail page in the Console?

acme-dev: Pasted from the token list. Header we sent (masked): `Bearer svc-prod-abc123` (we think that matches the string shown in the list). We clicked the copy icon next to the token row and it copied that.

nate.eng: Quick check — often the short `svc-` string is the token ID (an identifier), not the secret. Secrets are long opaque strings. Can you try fetching the token detail (click token name -> detail) and using the "Copy secret" button there? Also try `curl -v` to show what was actually sent to the server.

acme-dev: Tried what you said — when I copy the secret from the token detail page and replace the header with the long secret (masked `sk_live_***xY7`), requests started returning 200. Looks like the id was copied instead of secret.

julia.support: Great, glad that fixed it. For clarity: the token list shows the token ID (human-friendly, starts with `svc-...`) and the detail page exposes the secret (starts with `sk_` or a long base64-like string). Using the token ID in Authorization will return 401.

nate.eng: Thanks, this looks like a UX hiccup — copy icon on the token list copies the token ID (intended) but customers often expect it to be the secret. We'll add a clearer label and a tooltip. @irene.oncall can you triage a Console bug? Repro steps: on Token list, hover copy icon, click -> clipboard contains token id (starts with `svc-`) rather than secret; browser: Chrome 114+ on macOS.

irene.oncall: Acknowledged. I'll create a Console issue with repro, and we'll consider changing the icon or adding a confirm modal before copying a secret on the list page. Assigning to console-ui. I'll include a note to check copy behavior for accessibility/parity across browsers.

deploy-bot: Created issue CONSOLE-1429: "Token list copy action ambiguous (copies ID, not secret) — causes 401 when used as secret" — linked to this thread.

julia.support: Summary for the customer: root cause = token ID (svc-...) was pasted into Authorization instead of the token secret. Fix/workaround = use the Copy secret button on the token detail page (or rotate/create a new secret if unsure). We're also tracking a Console bug (CONSOLE-1429) to make the copy action clearer. Sorry for the confusion and glad you're back online :thumbsup:

acme-dev: Thanks everyone — good to know. We'll rotate the secret and update our deployment to reference the secret value. Appreciate the quick help!"
